description: This file implements an asynchronous SCGI request handler for testing environment checks by parsing SCGI requests over a socket, extracting query-related environment variables, and responding accordingly. It includes functionality for accepting connections, parsing request headers, and handling request processing asynchronously.

classes.name: ScgiRequest
classes.description: A dataclass representing the parsed SCGI request containing headers and body.

methods.name: ScgiRequest parse_scgi_request(reader: asyncio.StreamReader)
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses an SCGI request from a StreamReader, returning a ScgiRequest object.

methods.name: None handle_scgi(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter)
methods.description: Handles an individual SCGI connection, parsing the request and sending a response.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Sets up the socket server (either TCP or Unix domain socket) and serves requests indefinitely.

ctags.name: handle_scgi
ctags.pattern: /^async def handle_scgi(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:$/
